definitions.explanation: A section of tree trunk that has been cut but not yet processed into lumber. Retains its round, natural shape.

examples.japanese: {丸太|まるた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸太|まるた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れて→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧きた。
examples.english: A log came floating down the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧{場|じょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸太|まるた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a bench made from logs at the campground.

notes:
{丸太|まるた} refers to a log — a section of tree trunk that has been cut but retains its round, natural shape. Not yet processed into boards or lumber.

FORMS:
⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ (round) + {太|た} (thick). Describes the round, thick shape of an uncut tree trunk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丸太小屋|まるたごや}: log cabin
- {丸太|まるた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut logs
- {丸太|まるた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to assemble logs
- {丸太|まるた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to carry/transport logs
- {丸太|まるた}{橋|ばし}: log bridge

USAGE:
Appears in forestry, construction, camping, and nature contexts. {丸太小屋|まるたごや} (log cabin) is probably the most commonly encountered compound.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧: lumber, timber (processed wood)
- ⟦{材木|ざいもく}→材木：04190_zaimoku⟧: building timber
- {丸太|まるた}: raw, unprocessed log
